title: biyaakite roocih sabri
intro: aydaadih addat, migaq kaak cilmi lih sitta ceela num yan. ta numtin amo gibbatu baadal tan kulli raacat wayti luk, uxih raqtem gine taama abeena. Sanootah gibdaabinittee kee xagar biyaakitteh addat, ta roocih sorkocô baxi amaanat raaqeh, gibdaabinitteh addat yan marah inkih qaagoh iffonta xayyoysak suge.
clues: Anu Yallih diggale taama abeynak sugeeh, mango gaddaay, mango xayloo kee meqe qaafiyat luk suge.
Yi mano fakim beyte wak anu inni gadda kee inni buxah marak, inni amaanat dubuk tu yoo cabte.
Anu sahdayti baxih coolaysih waado gibbateh yan xer waktih biyak le biyaakah biyaakiteh suge.
yi ganditih addat, anu inni degeltal malkit cineh, walaa qaduwwi niya yirgiqeh yoo miraacisam gabbate wak.
Anu ellecaboh yi Rabbih seece wak, Anu gadda masserra, takkay immay uxxuuk too taqabi yoo xagem oggoleh.
Anu inni ibat ardi aatukem yoh warseenih sugeenim kee tohuk xabcin lee raceena temeete yi xagar daylisuh kee yi bakaar bargusuh.

arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
